name: West India Coastal Current: winter regional reach
scope: OSW regional offshore path between fixed 10 N and 22 N gates, motivated by two latitude-specific descriptions in the winter study abstract. Neither gate is an established whole-current endpoint; continuity and axis location are not reconstructed from observations.
layer: Poleward upper coastal current context; no fixed numerical sampling layer or current axis. Excludes the southward undercurrent and does not equate shallow shelf variability with the slope current.
time_convention: December 1987 and January 1988 study context from the publisher abstract; not an observed trajectory, simultaneous continuous survey axis, modern climatology or annual envelope.
source_citation: Shetye et al. (1991), The coastal current off western India during the northeast monsoon, Deep Sea Research Part A 38(12), 1517-1529, doi:10.1016/0198-0149(91)90087-V.
source_locator: Publisher-indexed abstract: study months, poleward coastal flow, southern description near 10 N and northern slope-flow description near 22 N. Full methods and figures unavailable.
source_license: Attributed geographic facts and OSW original geometry only; no source abstract, figures or velocity data redistributed.

supporting_sources.role: Shelf-versus-slope scope caution; remote-forcing distance is not route length.

coordinate_selection: Every longitude and intermediate latitude is an OSW editorial choice offshore of western India. Only the two approximate latitude contexts come from the 1991 abstract. No velocity axis, isobath, geographic current boundary or physical endpoint is measured.
scenario_rule: Three declared offshore placements at fixed latitude gates; no endpoint uncertainty or seasonal variability estimated.
remaining_gates: Original winter methods and figures remain unreviewed.
Longitude placements and alignment with the continental slope are unverified.
A drawn connection is editorial, not observational evidence of continuous flow.
Whole-current endpoints and seasonal length ranges remain unknown.
Scientific admission and runtime integration are pending; coverage counts remain unchanged.
revision_reason: Presentation-only: show WICC and study months in the visible map title. Geometry, scenarios and numerical method are unchanged from v1.
